final: WITH t AS (SELECT a.player_id, SUM(a.g_1b - a.g_cf) AS total FROM appearances a JOIN player p ON p.player_id = a.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.death_country) <> '' AND a.g_1b IS NOT NULL AND a.g_cf IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(CAST(a.g_1b AS TEXT)) <> '' AND TRIM(CAST(a.g_cf AS TEXT)) <> '' GROUP BY a.player_id), av AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS m FROM t) SELECT SUM(t.total) AS sum_totals, AVG(t.total - av.m) AS avg_excess FROM t, av WHERE t.total > av.m
